storageRules: Every original log/metadata/preflight retains its own path, even when bytes are identical or empty.

The already durable manifest, recorder, execution plan, canonical R1, Host-source inventory, D-build receipts/output inventory and earlier E/F/G/H proof snapshots are mapped by exact Git bytes and are not copied again.
Absolute scratch paths preserve execution provenance; corresponding proposed or existing repository paths are the durable review locations.
This inventory and the Plan29 appendix are publication-envelope files, excluded from their own payload list to avoid self-hash cycles.
No signed downloads, upload helper code, archive reconstruction, source application or project execution is added.
qualificationLimits: All results are local Linux observations of I88ada/tree6ea; not qualification of later author heads or the current PR.
The eight-helper run and the three-file finite Node/Vitest run passed115 and53 respectively; no native C++/Windows/macOS controller/provider execution is implied.
Named whole scripts/native/retained-host TypeScript projects passed; no separate root backend-test-project rerun or reconstruction of historical Killed137 argv is claimed.
The original94 selected dependency files were checked; this is not a full node_modules freeze.
The1446 development output payloads are reused unchanged from actual D builds; stage I did not rebuild them or establish a new platform payload.
YAML results are syntax/mapping checks for two files, not Actions schema, permissions, expressions, scheduling or runtime execution.
Historical failures and skipped/cancelled evidence stay source-bound. Resulting original CI/UI/native/P08/P09 acceptance remains required.
No source/ref/PR changes, project tests, compilers, native launch or CI polling were performed by this independent reviewer.
